Context: 11. Conditions.-

- (3) Option to be exercised within 3 months from the date of declaration of results (or date of joining if results declared while on leave), for drawal of increment either from the first of the month following the announcement of results, or from the date of annual increment falling due after the results. Personal Pay will not be granted if option not exercised within 3 months. Extension of time may be allowed in special cases.
